description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes. Enemies in a 5-foot emanation attempt a basic Reflex save against your class DC against 1d4 fire damage per 2 levels, rounded up. On a failure or critical failure, they also take 1d4 persistent fire damage, increasing to 2d4 at 12th level. Persistent damage is not doubled on a critical failure and ends normally using recovery checks; it has no fixed three-round duration.

@Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2))d4[fire]] — @Check[type:reflex|against:gunbreaker|basic:true]; persistent @Damage[(1+floor(@actor.level/12))d4[persistent,fire]]
